title: Deep Q-Networks
oneLine: Replace the Q-table with a network - stabilized by replay and a target net.

paras: When states are too many to tabulate (pixels, say), approximate Q with a neural network. Two tricks keep it from diverging: a replay buffer that breaks the correlation between consecutive samples, and a slowly-updated target network that provides a stable regression goal. Together they made deep RL work on Atari.
Regress the network Q toward a target built from a frozen copy:
sections.texNote: theta^- is the target network, copied from theta every so often.

sections.caption: Replay decorrelates data; the target net stabilizes the goal.

takeaways: DQN approximates Q with a neural network.
A target network gives a stable regression target.
